issue.title: ERR lldp#lldpmgrd[32]: unknown operation error log is seen during breakout tests

failure.body:
#### Description

When a redis event quickly gets outdated during port breakout, error logs like this are seen

#### Describe the results you received:

```
Mar  8 <IPV6>.011724 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Write in DB: {'PORT': {'Ethernet64': {'admin_status': 'down'}, 'Ethernet68': {'admin_status': 'down'}}}
Mar  8 <IPV6>.012565 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Writing in Config DB
Mar  8 <IPV6>.013468 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Write in DB: {'PORT': {'Ethernet64': None, 'Ethernet68': None}, 'INTERFACE': None}
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018095 r-leopard-56 NOTICE swss#portmgrd: :- doTask: Configure Ethernet64 admin status to down
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018309 r-leopard-56 NOTICE swss#portmgrd: :- doTask: Delete Port: Ethernet64
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018641 r-leopard-56 NOTICE lldp#lldpmgrd[32]: :- pops: Miss table key PORT_TABLE:Ethernet64, possibly outdated
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018654 r-leopard-56 ERR lldp#lldpmgrd[32]: unknown operation ''
```

#### Describe the results you expected:

Error Log should not be seen

resolution.title: [lldpmgrd] Don't log error message for outdated event
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/14236

When a redis event quickly gets outdated during port breakout, error logs like this are seen

```
Mar  8 <IPV6>.011724 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Write in DB: {'PORT': {'Ethernet64': {'admin_status': 'down'}, 'Ethernet68': {'admin_status': 'down'}}}
Mar  8 <IPV6>.012565 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Writing in Config DB
Mar  8 <IPV6>.013468 r-leopard-56 INFO ConfigMgmt: Write in DB: {'PORT': {'Ethernet64': None, 'Ethernet68': None}, 'INTERFACE': None}
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018095 r-leopard-56 NOTICE swss#portmgrd: :- doTask: Configure Ethernet64 admin status to down
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018309 r-leopard-56 NOTICE swss#portmgrd: :- doTask: Delete Port: Ethernet64
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018641 r-leopard-56 NOTICE lldp#lldpmgrd[32]: :- pops: Miss table key PORT_TABLE:Ethernet64, possibly outdated
Mar  8 <IPV6>.018654 r-leopard-56 ERR lldp#lldpmgrd[32]: unknown operation ''
```

#### How I did it

Only log the error when the op is not empty and not one of ("SET" & "DEL" )
